in_sanskrit.name: Dimple
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Small indentation or mark
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dimple एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Hindu mythology, the name Dimple is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Dipana' which means 'shining'. This name is believed to bring brightness and radiance to the bearer's life. It is also associated with the goddess Lakshmi, symbolizing prosperity and good fortune.
